name: Kosaka Mikoto
source:
A woman with striking long black hair. She isn’t exactly strong-willed, but she has a determined and proactive personality. She’s caring and easygoing. She has a playful side and enjoys pulling pranks.

She has a voluptuous, attractive figure. She is tall and has a well-proportioned, model-like physique. She works in development and sales for a women’s lingerie manufacturer.

Among those hired at the same time, she is the most successful. She's viewed as an "elite", though she doesn't see herself that way. Recently, she's been suffering sexual harassment from her boss.

She and the protagonist were senpai and kouhai in high school, and she used to live next door to the protagonist’s family home.

She is a kind older sister figure who has looked out for him in various ways since elementary school. They happen to reunite by chance this time.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/366945/]Getchu[/url]]
